headline: Zacha scores twice as Bruins roll in Pittsburgh
takeaway: Boston answered Pittsburgh's early goal with three in the first period, and Pavel Zacha scored twice in a 6–2 win, the Bruins' third straight. Rookie James Hagens left after a cross-check to the back and did not return.

sections.label: 1st period
sections.text: Justin Brazeau put Pittsburgh ahead on its first shot at 9:04. Zacha tied it 1–1 at 12:07, Mark Kastelic redirected Frederic Brunet's point shot for a 2–1 lead at 15:04, and Elias Lindholm picked off an Erik Karlsson clearing pass and scored at 18:57.

sections.label: 2nd period
sections.text: Nick Robertson redirected Kaedan Korczak's shot to make it 3–2 at 7:57. Zacha answered at 14:24 for a 4–2 lead, and Morgan Geekie scored on a breakaway set up by Hampus Lindholm at 16:57, then hit the post about 20 seconds later.

sections.label: 3rd period
sections.text: Fraser Minten scored on a stretch pass from Geekie at 8:39. Hagens left early in the period after Samuel Girard cross-checked him in the lower back. All six Boston goals came at even strength, a season high.

performers.name: Pavel Zacha
performers.note: Tied it in the first and restored a two-goal lead right after Pittsburgh got within 3–2.

performers.name: Morgan Geekie
performers.note: Scored for a third straight game and set up Minten's goal in the third.

performers.name: Michael DiPietro
performers.note: Improved to 4–1–0 as Pittsburgh managed only 18 shots.

oppLine: Justin Brazeau and Nick Robertson scored, Kaedan Korczak had two assists, and Arturs Silovs made 18 saves.
